summary: Morningstar, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026 announcing that its Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of 50 cents per share, unchanged from the July payout. The dividend is payable October 30, 2026 to shareholders of record as of October 2, 2026. The press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1 and signed by CFO Michael Holt. No advisor, premium, or stake terms apply. This is an ordinary capital-return declaration; watch for future dividend growth or buyback activity rather than deal-related arbitrage.
